# Bhanu Kowshik

> Design engineer in San Francisco who designs and builds AI products end to end: the product design, the interface and the code. Founder of Verified Call; sole product designer at EverTutor (~2,000 learners, 8+ schools).

Start with the brief: it summarises every project and labels how each claim was measured (published method, customer pilot, production data, or self-reported).

## Brief
- [AI brief](https://bhanu.build/ai.md): who he is, each project's role and results, and the evidence behind every number.

- [Verified Call test results](https://verifiedcall.app/research): the published research page behind every Verified Call number (sample, conditions, false alarms, confidence bounds, dates).

## Case studies
- [Verified Call](https://bhanu.build/verified-call.html): founder; designed it and built it with AI coding agents. Checks the person on a video interview (real camera, same person, no hidden AI tool): a Mac and Windows app that checks the candidate and a panel inside Google Meet for the interviewer. First working version in 3 weeks; closed beta open to 20 companies, in talks with 5 hiring teams, no live interviews yet.
- [Stressie](https://bhanu.build/stressie-v4.html): founding product designer; designed in Figma and built the iOS app in SwiftUI. A stress check-in that pays for your evening; daily engagement 12% to 56% in V2 pilots.
- [EverTutor Live](https://bhanu.build/evertutor-live.html): sole product designer. A real-time voice AI tutor: 1:1 tutoring for about $5 an hour, against ~$250 an hour for a human tutor.
- [EverTutor Studio](https://bhanu.build/evertutor-studio.html): sole product designer and lead curriculum designer. The authoring tool that cut lesson creation from 104 hours to 4.

- [Visual review pack](https://bhanu.build/review/): rendered screenshots and short clips of every page at desktop and phone sizes, for reviewers who cannot render the site's WebGL, video and motion. Markdown version: https://bhanu.build/review/README.md
